method: Direct visual inspection of generated PNGs. 01-menu.png is byte-identical to inspected menu-1280.png. Automated original report is preserved unchanged.
observations: 960x540 and 1280x720 menus: headings, three choices, primary action and footer are within the viewport and readable.

Phone instructions panel at both TV viewports: controls and complete instruction text fit; primary action remains visible. Local browser displays open-on-TV placeholder, not a claimed real phone connection.

Three tracks at 8 and 20 seconds: distinct city/coast/canyon scenery, visible player and opponents, readable HUD/minimap/nitro/drift meter; no blank renderer or obvious control obstruction.
All three finish screens: correct selected track and readable finish rank/time/counts.
844x390 touch view: left/right/brake and drift/nitro controls fit inside the viewport; HUD remains legible.
scopeLimitations: Screenshots show shared browser game configuration version 0.1.1, with the repaired model/bundle hashes; they are not screenshots of a packaged Mac 0.1.3 executable.
Ordinary-input AI-assisted racing verifies regression/playability, not an independent LEFT/RIGHT direction oracle.
